Title: Azure DNS private zones is now available in Azure Government and Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure DNS private zones is now generally available in Azure Government and Azure China regions. Use Azure DNS private zones for DNS resolution across one or more virtual networks in Azure Government and Azure China clouds.

Azure DNS private zones provides a reliable and secure DNS service to manage and resolve domain names in an Azure virtual network without the need to add a custom DNS solution.

Learn more about Azure DNS private zones.
